name: text-thin-to-bold-in
title: Thin To Bold Entrance
description: Từng ký tự hiện ra mảnh như sợi chỉ rồi dày dần lên thành nét đậm, nối nhau từ trái sang.

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Split chars; each char opacity 0 → 1 over its first 0.2 s while wght 100 → 800 over 0.9 s easeOutCubic (CSS cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1); labelled power3.out), stagger 50 ms (demo capped 0.9 s total) from 0.3 s; glyphs grow in place (positions fixed). Loop exit: fade 2.9–3.2 s; loop 3.4 s. Params: from, to: độ đậm (100 → 800) · duration (0.9 s) · stagger (0.05 s). Each letter's box is fixed at its final width first, so the glyphs grow in place and nothing reflows.
